_comment_platform: QFX5241-64 (Garnet 0x0F1C) PDDF device descriptor — derived from qfx5241-64-rcb.dts and accton-drivers/qfx5241/
_comment_bus_numbers: SMBus iSMT (pci-0000-00-1f.4) = i2c-0. PCA9548@0x78 (MUX1) and PCA9548@0x70 (MUX2) hang off it. Port I2C buses are individual ocores-i2c-garnet controllers registered by qfx5241-jnx-garnet-core from pci-0000-02-00.0. Verify bus numbers with 'i2cdetect -l' on first boot.
_comment_topology: I2C bus topology: iSMT SMBus + two PCA9548 MUXes + one sub-MUX. Port I2C buses via ocores-i2c-garnet from CFPGA (pci-0000-02-00.0).
_comment_smbus: Intel iSMT SMBus (pci-0000-00-1f.4): two PCA9548 muxes @0x78 and @0x70, CPU-board EEPROM @0x51.
_comment_mux1: PCA9548 @0x78 on iSMT: Ch5=VRM ASIC power rails (xdpe12284/xdpe132g5).
_comment_mux2: PCA9548 @0x70 on iSMT: Ch0=FAN-CPLD+sub-MUX, Ch1=PSU I2C, Ch2-Ch3=MB temp sensors, Ch4=UCD90320.
_comment_mux3: PCA9548 @0x76 under MUX2 Ch0 (bus 0x20): Ch0=fan-board temp left (0x4D), Ch1=fan-board temp right (0x4E).
_comment_vrm: ASIC VRMs on MUX1 Ch5 (bus 0x15): 5x Infineon xdpe12284 + 1x xdpe132g5. Used for voltage/thermal monitoring.
_comment_ucd: UCD90320 power sequencer @0x11 on MUX2 Ch4 (bus 0x24). Provides rail sequencing, not directly monitored by PDDF.
_comment_fan: Fan: garnet-fancpld @0x33 on MUX2 Ch0 (bus 0x20). 4 trays x 2 fans. Fan presence via s32afc-fan-presence GPIO: tray0=bit7, tray1=bit6, tray2=bit5, tray3=bit4 (register 0x07, active-high).
_comment_psu: PSUs: shared psmi2c bus = MUX2 Ch1 (bus 0x21). PSU1 EEPROM @0x50 / PMBus @0x58; PSU2 EEPROM @0x51 / PMBus @0x59. Presence via garnet-psu platform driver sysfs (psu0_present/psu1_present). garnet64 FPGA has no irq-tmc GPIO chip.
_comment_temp: Temperature sensors (8): lm75 @0x48/0x4A/0x4B/0x4C on MUX2 Ch2 (bus 0x22), lm75 @0x49/0x4D on MUX2 Ch3 (bus 0x23), lm75 @0x4D/0x4E on MUX3 Ch0/Ch1 (buses 0x30/0x31). Thresholds from thermal_data.json.
_comment_led: System LEDs are provided directly via /sys/class/leds; PDDF LED creation is bypassed for now. qfx5241-leds binds the CFPGA 'fpga-system-leds' mfd cell (system LED); qfx5241-leds-jnx-i2cs binds the fancpld 'leds-i2cs' cell (fan LED).
_comment_sfp: Port control: 64 QSFP-DD (optoe3, ports 1-64) + 2 SFP28 (optoe2, ports 65-66) via CFPGA (pci-0000-02-00.0). Per-port I2C buses from ocores-i2c-garnet (CPLD1: ports 0-31, CPLD2: ports 32-63 + SFP). GPIO banks from garnet-gpio-gmc: CPLD1 = presence-cpld0/lpmod-cpld0/reset-cpld0, CPLD2 = presence-cpld1/lpmod-cpld1/reset-cpld1, SFP = presence-sfp/tx-dis-sfp.
_comment_thermal: Thermal management policy: poll interval and fan speed range.

_comment_voltage_sensors: Voltage sensors (6): V_OUT (in2_input) from each xdpe12284/xdpe132g5 VRM on MUX1 Ch5 (bus 0x15). virt_parent references VRM device for hwmon path resolution.
_comment_current_sensors: Current sensors (6): I_OUT (curr1_input) from each xdpe12284/xdpe132g5 VRM on MUX1 Ch5 (bus 0x15).
_comment_valuemap: Value maps: GPIO-to-boolean translation for presence and power-good signals.
_comment_port: Optics ports: PORT1-32 QSFP-DD via CPLD1 (ocores i2c-garnet id=0..31, buses 0x40-0x5f), PORT33-64 via CPLD2 (id=32..63, buses 0x60-0x7f), PORT65-66 SFP28 via CPLD2 (id=64..65, buses 0x80-0x81). Verify bus numbers with 'i2cdetect -l' on first boot.
